Fifteen representatives of the Young Men's Christian 
Association of Montreal are to make a month-long tour of the 


Far East, Middle East and Europe. 


The group will fly from Vancouver October 2nd and is 
to visit Tokyo, Hong Kong, Bangkok, New Delhi, Beirut, Jerusalem, 
Tel Aviv, Jordan, Salonika, Athens, Geneva and will return home 


October 3lst. 


Purpose of the nine-nation visit is to obtain first-hand 
knowledge of YMCA operations abroad and to observe how they 
have been adapted to meet the varying conditions of the countries 


in which they are located. Upon return to this country, the group 


Continued.. 


will submit a general report to the Metropolitan Board of 


Directors of the Montreal YMCA. 


The trip is a result of invitations made by governments 
of the countries to be visited. The YMCA does not establish 
its service in any country except by invitation of the government 
concerned and then only after investigation has shown that there 
is a real need of such a service. All expenses of the foreign- 
based YMCA personnel are met by the International Committee of 


the North American YMCA. 


Continued 


Nine Montrealers will be members of the group that 
numbers among its members representatives from the world of 
industry, commerce and medicine. All expenses will be paid 


by the delegates themselves. 


The nine Montrealers travelling with the party are Mr. and 
Mrs. W. N. Clelland, Dr. and Mrs. A. D. Richardson, Mr. and Mrs. 
H. W. Mawhinney, Mr. and Mrs. J. Fisher, and Mrs. M. E. Bridgman. 
The other five members of the party will join the group prior 


to departure from Vancouver.
